name: Coutiliers
headerMeta: Chivalric era · Charge cavalry · 115 leadership · T2 mastery
pitch: A lancer cavalry unit that excels with zero-cooldown charge spam when stacking Mastery and the two T5 charge-reduction doctrines. Load the Chargers trait to maximum stacks from far away; pair with the Lancer's Last Stand swap-trick to activate full-unit damage buffs after losses.

doctrines.name: Epic Charge Defence Doctrine
doctrines.note: −50% DMG taken while charging, −6s charge CD

doctrines.name: Epic Leadership Doctrine
doctrines.note: alternative to Sprint or Last Stand

battleRole.positioning: Open on charge from far enough away to fully load Chargers (DMG & speed increases stack every 1.5s, 0.5s with boots rune, max 3 stacks). {1}
battleRole.tips: With Mastery + the four listed charge doctrines, this unit reaches 0s charge CD — spam X-move and charge to loop. {1} Apply Lancer's Last Stand swap-trick: if spawned with it active, swap to another unit then back; if just lost the unit, pull from supply and swap back to apply the 40%-damage buff to 100% of headcount, not just the damaged remainder. {1}

controls.notes: Zero cooldown on charge is the core identity — achieved by stacking the Lancer Charge Doctrine (−14s), Epic Charge Defence (−6s), and Mastery synergy. {1}
